content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds asphalt plants sold to the same road builders and asphalt producers, with parts and installation support."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Road-building contractor and asset operator that uses asphalt plants rather than designing and selling them to producers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators and industrial users, not asphalt plants or road builders."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Municipal specialty vehicles and public safety equipment sold to cities and agencies, not asphalt plants to producers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and seals for process plants such as oil, chemicals and power, not asphalt or road construction equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pumps and valves alongside brake friction parts and connectors for rail, aerospace and industrial makers, not asphalt plants."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking and wood processing machinery for mills and sawmills, a different customer base and process than asphalt plants."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rail track components, friction management and precast concrete sold to railroads and transit agencies, not asphalt plants."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Switchgear and substations for electrical power distribution, not thermal process plants for asphalt production."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Emissions-certified engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers, not asphalt plants or road construction equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical fluids, lubricants and coatings for metalworking and steel, not asphalt plant equipment."}]}
